what_was_built: The extractor at build/facts was fixed in five source files: build_facts.js, py_extract.py, ts_extract.js, docs_extract.js and git_extract.js. The new extractor_version is 59da7b753a4d908e; the old one was e409baad8b0c794b.

(a) Leak removal. commits.jsonl now lists only commits an arm may use; a dropped commit is removed entirely, with no file list and no label. Each listed commit's pr label is computed only from the build commit's own history. meta.json names no task commit and no PR number. The task switch, the task PRs and the dropped commits go to build/sealed/facts_meta/<parent>.json (190 files) and to build/sealed/facts_meta/build_log.jsonl (190 lines).

(b) Co-change drop rule. A commit is dropped only when it belongs to the same PR as a task commit. The in-flight rule is removed. When a parent has task commits from several PRs, the union of their sibling commits is dropped; this happens on 26 of the 190 parents.

(c) Mobile config reads. Member chains on the mobile config object (such as config.attendance.maxDutyHours, config.video.* and config.compress.*) now produce reads_setting edges; the cause was that the walk stopped at the `as const` wrapper. The maxDutyHours invariant now has its constrains anchor.

(d) SQL table edges. SQL is now read only from string literals passed to text(), execute(), op.execute() or exec_driver_sql(). DELETE, UPDATE and INSERT count as writes. The evidence line is the line of the statement inside the literal.

(e) Recall holes closed: URLs built with a ternary; URL literals looped over a tuple or list, in Python and JS; unit-of-work writes through query-flow-typed loop variables; calls through a Protocol-typed attribute, which now also go to each implementing class at confidence 1/k; os.environ and os.getenv reads in Python; process.env and import.meta.env reads in the root Vite config files; and the invariant tokens start.sh, transition(), JobDetail.evidence and cursor.last_seq.

(f) Citations. A link's :line or :a-b suffix is stripped before resolving. Ambiguous citations are tie-broken by context, in this order: a path relative to a runtime root, then the document's folder, then the directories and slices of the files the section or document cites. attrs.context records which rule decided.

(g) Labelling fixes. is_test now covers vitest.setup.* and *_test.py. session.delete counts as a write only when the receiver is a session. A Settings method call is no longer a setting node. The key of a subscript assignment is no longer a setting read. The spurious slice backend/features is gone. When --skip or --only switches an edge kind off, nodes left without edges are pruned.
(h) Two parents were added to the cache: 8dafcecc (off main) and the frozen commit a31924a.

(i) The whole cache was rebuilt into cache.new and verified, then swapped in as build/facts/cache; cache.old was deleted. build_cache.js was rewritten and now takes the options --out, --conc, --only and --limit.

what_was_built: arms/search/arm.js was rewritten to the registry contract. open(G, opts) exports the parent tree once with git archive from paths.js REPO (GT_REPO=/repo in the image), parsed in memory so nothing is written. rank(seedIds, cfg, seed) returns {ranked, engine_ms, lookups, meta} with only the search's own head as canonical graph nodes. tq(q) returns {answer, tokens, lookups}. close() is a no-op.

New arms/search/search.js holds the search core with the private directory fill removed; padding now comes only from the shared packer option pad. It validates every search field and maps the result to graph nodes in one ranked list that does not depend on granularity, form or pad, as the harness rankKey requires. Each ranked entry has hop = the round (1 to 3), score = the file score rounded to 9 decimals, via = ["L<k>", "read<t>"] (k = the ledger index of the lookup that first found the node, t = tokens read up to that lookup), and path = null.

engine.js and lib.js now build the per-parent context from the canonical graph G: definitions come from G's nodes by integer id, and G.removed paths are dropped. Hard-coded Windows paths were replaced by arms/common/paths.js, and the tokenizer is the shared one.

arms/search/sweep.js has a new STAGE1 of exactly 40 configurations, written without any score, one factor at a time around the arm's own BASE. The base is file granularity, signature form, pad none, plus the pre-score search defaults. The entries: 7 shared-factor entries (pad DIR and CO, symbol granularity, paths and snippet forms); rounds 5 (rounds=1, rounds=3, k2=3, 8, 12); decay 2; terms 11 (routes, spellings, seedImports, nullNames, namesPerFile, genericCap, followImports); BM25 5; proximity 3; weights 6 (typeW, countW, idf). Plus a complexity() function for the simplest-within-one-SE rule. List hash ef02c4a27f96928a.

tq.js is now a module (answerTq) called through arm.tq(). It returns the SPEC section 12 format with tokens = the total of the search ledger. A question-specific hard-coded list of CLAUDE.md line numbers (116, 119, 127) was removed; no TUNE answer changed.

New arms/floor-dir and arms/floor-co: arm.js returns an empty head (lookups 1 for DIR, 2 for CO) and refuses any other pad or any traversal, rank or search fields. configs.js holds the full list (file or symbol granularity x signature, snippet, paths or range form = 8 configurations), and configs/*.json holds the same 8 for run.js --config.
